Specification: This module gives a very abstract specification of the consensus problem by modeling only the set of values that have been chosen. The system starts with no chosen values, allows a single step that chooses one value from the constant set Value, and then permits only stuttering thereafter through the temporal formula with the action subscript. It verifies a safety property stating that at most one value is ever chosen, using a TLAPS proof of an invariant; the comments explicitly note that liveness such as eventual choice is intentionally ignored.
